notes.title: Major Update Notice - Added Mutant Flame Card
notes.content:
Respected Players of "Game of Fate 2",

The new version 0.0.9 has introduced the Mutant Flame Card. Please update your client to version 0.0.9 as soon as possible after the new version is released. We will launch an event on March 18th at 10:00 AM, during which you will have a chance to obtain the Mutant Flame Card.

If you continue to use an older version after the event starts, you may encounter errors when claiming chests, resulting in failure to receive them successfully.
Thank you for your understanding and support!

Friendly Reminder: Restarting Steam can quickly fetch the update.

Attachment: Probability table for obtaining the Mutant Flame Card is provided below.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280261/d580ca5546fe6aac1678fde1eb72e411eb6169c7.png

notes.title: Update announcement-0116
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The development team of "Game of Fate 2" would like to say hello to everyone. Thank you for your support for "Game of Fate 2". We are working hard.

This version number is 0.0.7, and the update content is:
1. Unified video sound
2. Repair known problems

Warm reminder: Restart steam to quickly obtain updated content.
Please also participate in the ongoing Tarot card collection and exchange peripheral activities.
Event link: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3218600/view/520828168477606549
